findings.title: Global view permission bypasses client-specific denials
findings.body: canView(client) returns immediately when canView() grants the caller the all-clients view permission, without evaluating the client's own resource. Consequently, an administrator granted view on all clients can still read a client for which a client-specific view policy denies access. This defeats the resource-specific override behavior already tested for Users in UserResourceTypeEvaluationTest. Keep the administrative-role shortcut, but evaluate fine-grained view access through the client-specific resource before falling back to the all-clients resource.

findings.title: Deletion listener still invokes an unsupported V2 operation when both features are enabled
findings.body: The listener is guarded by ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ, but management() selects MgmtPermissionsV2 whenever ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 is enabled. If both features are enabled, deleting any client calls ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled(client, false), which unconditionally throws UnsupportedOperationException. The removal event therefore fails and can roll back client deletion, including deletion by a full administrator. Ensure this V1 cleanup listener does not dispatch to the V2 implementation.
